derives_from: published v2 tables only (no run dir, no prediction CSV)

n_ceiling.dz_no_interval_reason: No interval is reported for dz. A defensible interval for a standardized paired difference requires the noncentral-t distribution, which is not available here and is deliberately not approximated: at n=3 an invented interval would be worse than none. The unstandardized difference's Student-t 95% CI (published, and reproduced in this table) is the interval on the quantity the paper quotes; the leave-one-seed-out refits below show how unstable dz itself is, and are NOT a confidence interval.
n_ceiling.separability_note: No pair is statistically separable at n=3. The exact paired sign-flip permutation test's smallest attainable two-sided p is 2/2**3 = 0.25, so the ordering of two ratios cannot be established in either direction; a pair is classified only as consistently ordered across the three seeds (a description of those seeds) or order-unstable.
what_these_numbers_support: the direction and the standardized size of the difference *among these three seeds*, and whether all three agree in sign
the unstandardized difference with a Student-t 95% CI (already published by the main grid and reproduced here)
that the three interior ratios' worst-view CERs sit inside each other's intervals, i.e. a broad plateau rather than an identified optimum
what_these_numbers_do_not_support: any significance claim, in either direction: the exact paired test's floor at n=3 is p = 0.25
a population effect size: dz here is a ratio of two estimates from three points, and its leave-one-seed-out refits move by factors, not percents
a claim that one interior mix ratio is better than another: no pair is separable at n=3
any comparison with v1, whose corpus is abandoned
